Thanks, Evelyn. Your account is verified.

Your Tessera has one open recall, **NM-23R07: front passenger seat belt pretensioner wiring**. The fix is to inspect and replace the wiring harness. The dealer has parts for it, and the repair is done at no cost to you. It is marked as a safety recall, so I'd recommend booking it soon.

For Vaughan, the next open times I can see are:
- Tuesday, Nov 17 at 3:00 PM
- Wednesday, Nov 18 at 9:00 AM or 10:00 AM

I don't see any Thursday afternoon openings yet. Would one of these times work for your service?
